facts.text: The Shocker Promise covers tuition and fees for up to 15 credit hours each semester for qualifying Kansas freshmen with family income and assets of $60,000 or less.

sources.title: Shocker Promise - Wichita State University
sources.quote: The Shocker Promise is a 4-year, last-payee scholarship designed to cover remaining costs associated with tuition and fees and after applying all other gift aid

sources.title: Shocker Promise - Wichita State University
sources.quote: Annual family income of $60,000 or less and total assets of $60,000 or less.
